indicator_definition: This indicator measures the share of high-technology products in total exports of manufactured goods, expressed as a percentage. High-technology products have high R&D intensity, such as aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals and electronics. Data are compiled by Eurostat from trade statistics.
rationale: A high share of high-tech exports reflects technological competitiveness and innovation capacity. Developing high-tech industries supports quality job creation and sustainable growth. Progress means an increasing share of high-technology products in total exports.
methodology_characteristics: Data are compiled from trade statistics (COMEXT) using the OECD definition of high-technology sectors. High-technology products are classified using the Standard International Trade Classification (SITC). Data are published annually by Eurostat.
indicator_name: Share of high-tech exports in total exports
